reason: A is the better, more testable proposal because it specifies a matched tungsten comparison, measurable mechanical and in situ dislocation outcomes, and a falsification rule, while prior creep evidence at least supports dislocation-mediated deformation in TaTiVWZr. Its claim that lattice distortion enhances mobility is not firmly established and the design should better control grain size and phase state, but B relies on unsubstantiated precipitates and grain-boundary sliding, which may instead degrade toughness and creep resistance.
